cite: F. Alam, F. Ofli, M. Imran, CrisisMMD: multimodal Twitter datasets from natural disasters, in: Proc. 12th Int. AAAI Conf. Web and Social Media, 2018.
label: image_damage, three classes: severe_damage, mild_damage, little_or_no_damage
text_representation: CLIP text embedding reduced by PCA to 8 components, PCA fitted on training events only
arrival_times: recovered from the Twitter snowflake identifier; real, not synthesised
image_representation: CLIP image embedding reduced by PCA to 10 components, PCA fitted on training events only
payload_sizes: real: image byte sizes are the files on disk, text byte sizes are the UTF-8 length of the tweet. Neither is assumed.
not_modelled: no sensor modality exists in CrisisMMD; the workload has two modalities
no geolocation in the annotations; spatial admissibility degrades to event identity
no severity field independent of the label; severity is held constant
